newsitem.title: USA: Tanisys says to begin SmallCap trading.
newsitem.headline: Tanisys says to begin SmallCap trading.

text.p: Tanisys Technology Inc Thursday said it expects to begin trading its common stock today on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market under the symbol TNSU.

The company said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has completed its review of the company's registration application and the Nasdaq has approved of its listing application. The SEC review and Nasdaq's approval were the final steps needed before the stock could begin trading, the company said.
Tanisys Technology designs application-specific, standard memory modules and memory test solutions for electronic system applications and industries.
The company has been trading on the Vancouver Stock Exchange.
